thread:
alex: Heads up — nightly parallel CI shard 12/16 red on warmup again, h100. Looks like an OOM during kv-cache init.
rita: saw that in the smoke logs too. OOM spikes at ~1.6GB per process, which is weird for the warmup tiny batch.
alex: attaching the short log we captured:
```\n[2026-02-20T03:12:09Z] [shard=12] GPU 0: initializing KV cache
[2026-02-20T03:12:09Z] cudaErrorUnknown: invalid device function
[2026-02-20T03:12:09Z] OOM allocating 1.6G for kv_cache
```\ncheng: "invalid device function" + OOM could be a driver/ptx mismatch — did we roll any driver recently to that pool?
infra-bot: deploy:driver-rollout v535.101 -> v535.130 to pool=nightly-gpu completed 2026-02-19T22:47:31Z
alex: yep, infra-bot says a driver flip happened last night on that node pool.
max: can we confirm which machines the shard landed on? I can trigger a focused rerun on the same hosts.
rita: shard mapping from the job: shard 12 -> nightley-gpu-17, nightley-gpu-18 (round robin). Both are on 535.130 per infra.
cheng: quick sanity — can someone try rerunning with older driver pin on that job to see if it reproduces? If it doesn't, we bisect drivers.
alex: @max can you kick a rerun pinned to 535.101? command I use:
```bash\nCI_RUN_PIN_DRIVER=535.101 ./devtools/ci-rerun --job parallel-smoke --shard 12
```\nmax: started rerun pinned to 535.101 now, will post logs when done. ETA ~6m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: if CI is flaky and blocks merges, escalate to #eng-oncall after 30m.

rita: also saw rare kernel XID 31 in older logs (link: https://ci.internal/logs/xyz) — might be two separate issues colliding.
alex: if rerun passes on 535.101 then it's driver regression. If it still fails, we should bisect the PRs that touched allocator/kv cache in last 48h.
max: rerun finished — PASS on 535.101. PASS on both hosts.
cheng: that is telling. Looks like driver regression. I'll open a bisect ticket for infra to roll back or pin.
alex: thanks. For immediate relief, let's pin nightly pool back to 535.101 and schedule a slow canary for 535.130 on a subset.
rita: created infra ticket INF-4422 and added logs + pass/fail artifacts.
max: filing a brief postmortem note in the job ticket, including this snippet. Also adding a flaky-test marker to the job while infra patches.
cheng: next actions:
- infra: pin pool -> 535.101 (urgent)
- infra: run driver-bisect between 535.101..535.130 on sample nodes
- eng-ml: add extra safety check in warmup to avoid large kv allocations on driver mismatch
alex: assigning to @cheng + @infra on the ticket. If anyone wants to pick up the bisect, I left the driver test script at tools/driver-bisect.sh
max: quick note for recorder — add `--collect-cuda-props` to smoke to capture cuda driver: `CI_ENV_EXTRA='--collect-cuda-props'`
rita: thanks all. I'll update the CI config once infra confirms pin.
alex: :thumbsup: closing thread once pin is confirmed.
